study_role: post-hoc component ablation on historically evaluated FIVES; not an independent confirmation cohort

arm_definitions.core: gray + 0.1 * tanh(raw residual); zero-initialized output convolution
arm_definitions.no_bound: gray + 0.1 * raw residual; same zero-initialized output convolution; only tanh is removed
arm_definitions.random_init: gray + 0.1 * tanh(raw residual); only the output convolution retains its original PyTorch default random weight and bias initialization

shared.precision: float32; no AMP; historical TF32 policy from set_seed
shared.training_loss: 0.5 BCEWithLogitsLoss + 0.5 soft Dice; full image grid; Dice smoothing 1e-6
shared.checkpoint_selection: highest full-grid validation soft Dice among epochs 0 through 30; strict improvement, earlier epoch wins ties
shared.optimizer_reset: once per arm from the same grayscale GN checkpoint; no moments carried from source checkpoint
shared.training_augmentation: frozen_base/data_utils.py unchanged from historical CARER implementation
shared.test_checkpoint_use: all nine validation-selected checkpoints are sealed before any new official-test image is discovered

primary_endpoint_family: Dice for each of two contrasts
thin_centerline_recall for each of two contrasts

bootstrap.unit: crossed training seed x test image; shared pair indices

historical_local_contrast_analysis: report all seven existing color-control arms separately with their exact provenance; RGB-only has 985 added parameters, so it is not a parameter-count-matched cue ablation
